name: Bergenhus

stay_areas.name: Around Bryggens Museum
stay_areas.best_for: First visits arranged around Hanseatic Museum and Schøtstuene and the harbour front
stay_areas.why: Rooms a few minutes from Bryggens Museum, St Mary's Church and Korskirken, which puts the whole of central Bergenhus on foot
